bull_case: Rubrik is moving cyber recovery from backup administration toward autonomous data, identity and AI-agent resilience. Strong ARR expansion, >119% NRR and new Agent Cloud integrations suggest a broader control plane may emerge.
bear_case: The core product may remain a premium but sustaining cyber-resilience platform rather than a new value-chain standard. Agent Cloud adoption and economics are not separately disclosed, and large incumbents can bundle competing security controls.
thesis: Rubrik shows real adoption and product expansion, but the evidence supports meaningful structural innovation rather than a proven 10x disruption. ARR, large-customer growth and >119% NRR validate customer pull. Agent Cloud, agent identity and autonomous recovery open adjacent value pools, yet separate monetization and independent cost/performance proof remain early.

evidence.claim: Subscription ARR was $1.66B, up 33% y/y; cloud ARR was $1.48B, up 39%; 3,084 customers had at least $100K of subscription ARR, up 23%.
Average subscription dollar-based NRR was above 119% as of July 31, 2026, indicating existing subscription customers collectively expanded spend despite churn and contraction.

Rubrik Agent Cloud became generally available in 2026 and added integrations for Anthropic Claude Code and Google's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, extending the platform from data recovery into AI-agent governance, control and rewind.
Rubrik introduced Agent Identity to monitor agents and MCP servers, control tool-level access and remediate unwanted actions, adding identity/authorization to the AI-agent resilience stack.
Q2 GAAP gross margin was 78.4% and subscription ARR contribution margin improved to 14.0% from 9.4%, showing adoption is not occurring with deteriorating gross economics.

counterevidence: No independent evidence shows a 10x cost/performance improvement across the full platform.
Agent Cloud revenue, ARR, retention and margin are not separately disclosed, so product announcements cannot yet be equated with commercial adoption.
Security incumbents and hyperscalers have strong distribution and can bundle adjacent identity, data and AI governance capabilities.
Partner/channel concentration means rapid top-line adoption may partly reflect distribution strength rather than proprietary end-user lock-in.
unknowns: Standalone Agent Cloud ARR, customer count and gross margin.
Independent recovery-time/TCO benchmarks versus Cohesity, Veeam, hyperscaler-native tools and security suites.
Attach rate of identity and AI-agent products to existing Rubrik Security Cloud customers.
Whether the platform becomes a standard control layer or remains an integrated vendor product.
falsifiers: Cut adoption_curve if ARR growth falls below 20% and NRR below 110% for two quarters.
Cut optionality if Agent Cloud remains commercially immaterial through FY2028.
Cut cost_performance_shift if independent benchmarks show no material recovery/TCO advantage versus bundled alternatives.
next_checks: Obtain independent cyber-recovery TCO and restore-time benchmarks.
Track Agent Cloud/Agent Identity paid adoption rather than product announcements.
Measure attach rates across data, identity and AI-agent resilience.

subscores.rationale: Rubrik materially changes recovery automation and resilience workflows, but available cutoff evidence does not establish a broad 10x cost/performance discontinuity. This sits between sustained and structural innovation.
ARR +33%, cloud ARR +39%, >$100K customers +23%, NRR >119% and improving contribution margin provide direct evidence of accelerating mainstream enterprise adoption with improving economics.

Core cyber resilience plus Agent Cloud/agent identity represent at least two adjacent value pools with major ecosystem integrations. Incumbents remain well-capitalized and capable, so the rubric's stronger 85-style standard is not met.

uncertainties.rationale: Most performance claims are vendor-originated and lack a matched independent benchmark.
Core platform adoption is well evidenced, but the contribution from newly launched AI products is not.
Adjacent products may increase attach rates without creating a separate durable value pool.
